name: Typeform MCP
description: Lets agents build and edit Typeform forms, publish automations, manage contacts, and query response analytics over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Form Building
skills.description: Creates and edits Typeform forms, including fields and logic, and publishes them through the forms tool group.

skills.name: Automation Publishing
skills.description: Builds and publishes automations with email, webhook, delay, and integration steps through the automations tools.

skills.name: Contact Lists
skills.description: Manages contacts and lists, including bulk upsert and mapping form fields to contacts, through the contacts tools.

skills.name: Response Insights
skills.description: Queries raw submission data, aggregates, rankings, and time-series insights for a form's responses.
